page.layout: One title page, single column, centred lines. Printed lines run from the top author line down to the imprint at the foot. Library stamps and shelf marks are left out.
page.notes: Title page with the book's title, author and imprint. Most lines are faint or overprinted by show-through from the verso, so the wording is uncertain and many lines are marked illegible. The large word "INTRODUCTIO" is the most legible line, but it may be partly mirrored show-through. The imprint and date at the foot are largely unreadable. Library stamp "STADTBIBLIOTHEK COBLENZ", the shelf marks "5580:61" and "VD 17: 668979N", and the handwritten marks were left out as instructed. The page is a title page with no page number, running head or catchword.
